summary: Example [iosxr:vars] for NETCONF uses ansible.netcommon.netconf with cisco.iosxr.iosxr, user, vaulted password and proxy command.
questions: What inventory settings do I need for IOS-XR over NETCONF?

answer_card.title: IOS-XR NETCONF inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[iosxr:vars]
ansible_connection=ansible.netcommon.netconf
ansible_network_os=cisco.iosxr.iosxr
ansible_user=myuser
ansible_password=!vault |
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command='-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
